note: PPC FY 25: other claims of earlier years paid in FY2024-25 (additional coal and change in law for FY2022-23 and FY2023-24, with their carrying cost; rows 69–77) — the ARR's arrears line (row 22).  These rows print only their billed amount (P, typed: the bill), so it is given; net of rebate (R) and with transmission (V) are computed.

blank_is_zero.why: NPCL leaves a charge blank where a source has none; its totals (P = SUM(M:O), R = P − Q, U = S + T, V = U + R) read the blanks as zero
